source: HMXBs: Fortin et al. 2023, A&A 671, A149 (VizieR J/A+A/671/A149), Gaia EDR3 distances (Bailer-Jones et al. 2021). LMXBs: Fortin et al. 2024, A&A 684, A124 (VizieR J/A+A/684/A124), Gaia or literature distances. Wolf–Rayet stars: van der Hucht 2001, VIIth catalogue (VizieR III/215), photometric distances. Novae: Schaefer 2022, MNRAS 517, 6150 (VizieR J/MNRAS/517/6150). Cataclysmic variables: Canbay et al. 2023, AJ 165, 163 (VizieR J/AJ/165/163), Gaia DR3 distances; subtypes, masses and eclipses from Ritter & Kolb (VizieR B/cb). Cepheids: Skowron et al. 2019, Science 365, 478 (VizieR J/other/Sci/365.478), period–luminosity distances. Masers: Reid et al. 2019, ApJ 885, 131 (VizieR J/ApJ/885/131), VLBI parallaxes. Positions in galactic coordinates, distances in kpc, periods in days, spins in seconds, masses in solar masses, ages in Myr.
